crossRefs.note: Yahweh God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”
Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.

people.name: Adah
people.line: Wife of Lamech; mother of Jabal and Jubal

people.name: Lamech
people.line: Descendant of Cain; first polygamist mentioned in the Bible

people.name: Zillah
people.line: Wife of Lamech; mother of Tubal-Cain and Naamah

translations.web: Lamech took two wives: the name of the first one was Adah, and the name of the second one was Zillah.
translations.bsb: And Lamech married two women, one named Adah and the other Zillah.
translations.kjv: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.
translations.asv: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.
